name: Pork
source:
Pork tells the story of an overworked housewife named Dolores Russo who is trying to get dinner done before her abusive husband, Gino, gets home. As she’s cooking, she discovers that her food has taken on a life of its own.

[From [url=https://crowbrainstudios.itch.io/pork]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《猪肉》讲述了一位名叫多洛雷斯·鲁索 (Dolores Russo) 的家庭主妇劳累过度的故事，她试图在虐待她的丈夫吉诺 (Gino) 回家之前完成晚餐。当她做饭时，她发现她的食物有了自己的生命。

[来自[url=https://crowbrainstudios.itch.io/pork]Itch.io[/url]]
